name: Downpour Dash! [NEW MAP!]
desc:
✨ Downpour Dash! is in no way affiliated with Flood Escape, Flood Escape 2 (FE2), or Crazyblox Games Ltd

🏃 Welcome to Downpour Dash! In this game, you must outrun the approaching danger in various musically-themed maps! Work together with friends, activate switches, and reach the end!

👥 Play solo, or team up with friends!

💭 Inspired by Crazyblox's Flood Escape 2

🎤 Be sure to join our Sandustries group!
